articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified, industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, announced today that it will participate in Morgan Stanley’s 14th Annual Laguna Conference on Wednesday, September 16, 2026. Conference participation will be in-person and will include one-on-one meetings with institutional investors to discuss dynamics across the various markets PHINIA serves around the world and the Company’s business. PHINIA’s Senior VP and ​CFO, Chris Gropp, and VP and Treasurer, Gordon Muir, will participate in the one-on-one meetings. articles.summary: PHINIA’s latest global reference guide continues a project first established by Delphi in 1993 to help industry professionals navigate evolving emissions requirements The 2026/2027 edition covers heavy-duty and off-road applications, bringing greenhouse gas requirements together with conventional pollutant emissions standards, testing requirements, and monitoring guidance PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified, industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, today announced the publication of its 2026/2027 Worldwide Heavy-Duty and Off-Road Emission Standards booklet, providing OEMs, engineers, policymakers, and other industry professionals with a practical reference to help navigate emissions requirements across global markets.
